H.  ORAL COUNCIL REPORT(S)

Councilmember Del Rio thanked Public Works staff for their proactive response during the severe
storm; reported that she attended the Independent Cities Association Conference on Public Safety.

Councilmember Roa reported that he attended the Independent Cities Association Conference on
Public Safety.

Mayor Pro Tem De Paula reported that Fergeson Elementary School had read over 1,700 books in a 3­
months period; placed 7th out of 19 elementary schools in a recent spelling bee; and received a state
grant to hire a literacy coach; Hawaiian Elementary School increase in achievement in state testing for
all student groups; and reported that he attended the Independent Cities Association Conference on
Public Safety.

Mayor Farfan reported he attended a Public Safety round table with Assemblywoman Sharon Quirk­
Silva; attended Melbourne Elementary Great Kindness week parade; grand opening of Shor restaurant;
Little League pancake breakfast fundraiser; ABCUSD Town Hall meeting; Senior Valentine Day Event;
and Rugby Event.

Councilmember Vargas requested that staff look at a survey/solution/suggestions for what other cities
are doing to deal with parking issues.

Ernesto Marquez, City Manager, spoke.
